scope: Resolved total-intensity radio-survey constraints for lowsky comparison plots; source survey maps, not ULSA/LFSM/GSM predictions.
units: Rayleigh-Jeans brightness temperature K unless specified

local_files.valid_pixel_definition: finite and not -32768; missing and sidelobe-affected pixels=-32768 in downloaded map
finite and not -32768; northern unobserved region=-32768 in downloaded map

surveys.frequency_note: 10.03 MHz is the downloaded FITS FREQ header; survey commonly called 10 MHz.
surveys.coverage: Original RA 0-16 h, declination -6 to +74 degrees; valid downloaded pixels 27.621% of sky.
surveys.beam_fwhm_deg: 2.6 EW x 1.9 NS sec(z), position dependent
surveys.zero_level: Absolute zero-level uncertainty not verified; do not fit monopole as a strong independent constraint.
surveys.point_sources: Treatment in LAMBDA gridded map not verified; mask bright sources for diffuse-only comparison.
surveys.errors: No per-pixel error map found on LAMBDA product page; calibration uncertainty not verified.
surveys.independence: Observed data, but 10-MHz survey also contributes to ULSA-related empirical inputs; check exact ULSA lineage before claiming fully independent calibration.
surveys.license: LAMBDA public download; explicit redistribution license not located. Retain source attribution and review terms before redistribution.

surveys.coverage: Declination -28 to +80 degrees, about 73%; valid downloaded pixels 72.731% of sky.
surveys.beam_fwhm_deg: About 1.1 EW x 1.7 NS sec(z) in Roger et al.; position dependent. LAMBDA page rounds differently.
surveys.zero_level: Roger et al. report a possible 5 kK 22-MHz zero-level error for spectral-index sensitivity and ±10 kK T-T offsets; 22-MHz declination gain was adjusted using Haslam 408 MHz.
surveys.point_sources: Cas A, Cyg A, Tau A, Vir A removed; other point sources remain and are unreliable for flux work. Downloaded map also masks sidelobe-affected pixels.
surveys.errors: No per-pixel error map in downloaded product; zero-level and declination calibration systematics dominate large-scale spectral comparisons.
surveys.independence: Observed sky morphology, but 408-MHz Haslam was used to correct the declination-dependent scale; a 22/408 slope is not independent of that calibration.
surveys.license: LAMBDA public download; explicit redistribution license not located. Retain source attribution and review terms before redistribution.

surveys.frequency_note: Combined southern 45-MHz and northern 46.5-MHz observations; do not call the entire pixel product an exact 45-MHz measurement.
surveys.coverage: Southern declination -90 to +19.1 degrees, northern +5 to +65 degrees; valid downloaded pixels 96.181% of sky.
surveys.beam_fwhm_deg: South 4.6 RA x 2.4 Dec; north 3.6 x 3.6; Guzman et al. combined spectral-index product at 5-degree resolution.
surveys.zero_level: LAMBDA-hosted map has not received EDGES-derived scale 1.076 ± 0.034 and offset -160 ± 78 K (both 2 sigma); preserve correction uncertainty as nuisance.
surveys.point_sources: Point-source subtraction status in this downloaded product not verified; mask A-team and compact-source apertures for diffuse test.
surveys.errors: No paired per-pixel uncertainty product on LAMBDA page; EDGES absolute-calibration terms are available separately.
surveys.independence: Direct survey maps; ULSA and other sky models also ingest 45-MHz survey data, so report conditioning overlap.
surveys.license: LAMBDA public download; explicit redistribution license not located. Retain source attribution and review terms before redistribution.

surveys.coverage: North of declination -40 degrees; actual per-frequency valid masks must be read from FITS.
surveys.beam_fwhm_deg: Frequency dependent, about 4.7 at 35 MHz to 2.0 at 80 MHz.
surveys.zero_level: Interferometric missing large scales restored using LEDA absolute total power and a forward model; reported conservative calibration uncertainty 15-25%, with systematic low temperatures near southern coverage edge.
surveys.point_sources: Bright compact sources remain visible in images; mask or add model A-team response consistently.
surveys.errors: Per-frequency HEALPix uncertainty products exist; snapshot-variation uncertainty does not replace global flux-scale systematic.
surveys.independence: Direct LWA1 observations, but ULSA uses low-frequency survey inputs and this project uses ULSA global tuning; do not treat agreement of absolute levels as wholly independent.
surveys.license: LAMBDA public download; explicit redistribution license not located.

surveys.zero_level: Product zero-level uncertainty should be treated as a fitted nuisance; a current authoritative numerical value for this exact version was not verified here.
surveys.point_sources: Use source-subtracted/destriped product for diffuse tests; bright Galactic sources intentionally retained. The synthetic small-scale-added NSIDE-2048 variant is unsuitable as direct measured small-scale evidence.
surveys.errors: No per-pixel uncertainty product on LAMBDA download page; original/processing systematics remain.
surveys.independence: Observed 408-MHz map; lowsky does not import its pixels, but its emissivity normalization and loop contrasts use 408-MHz-based literature anchors, and 22-MHz survey scale also references Haslam.
surveys.license: LAMBDA public download; explicit redistribution license not located.

published_measurements.observable: T proportional to frequency^-beta, 22 to 408 MHz
published_measurements.value: Mean beta=2.47 away from plane; extended regional means 2.41 at synchrotron minimum to 2.54 near Loop III, rms about 0.03.
published_measurements.qualification: Published source statement, not a new measurement; 22-MHz declination gain tied to Haslam and zero-level error affects exact beta.

published_measurements.value: Index spans about 2.1-2.7 at 5-degree resolution; low-latitude values below 2.5 attributed to free-free absorption.
published_measurements.qualification: Published survey-derived result; both endpoints enter sky-model lineages and 45-MHz calibration uncertainty remains.

published_measurements.observable: Diffuse total-intensity C_ell power-law exponent after bright-source subtraction and latitude cuts
published_measurements.value: alpha from -3.0 to -2.6, steepest at higher Galactic latitude; strong patch variation.
published_measurements.qualification: 408/1420-MHz result, not a direct low-frequency angular-spectrum measurement. Reproduce sky mask and ell interval before comparison.

published_measurements.observable: 408-MHz angular-power exponent used for synthetic small-scale addition
published_measurements.value: gamma=-2.703 fitted over ell=30-90 in original measured map.
published_measurements.qualification: Only original measured map is evidence; the high-resolution small-scale-added map is a simulation.
